A '''fleet''' of various destroyers and cruisers served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was used to [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|defend]] the planet [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]] during the Clone Wars, where a CIS prison, the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]], was located.

==History==
[[File:BattleOfLolaSayuEscape-CR.png|thumb|left|200px|The fleet engages the rescue fleet sent by the Republic]]
The fleet was stationed over the world of Lola Sayu during the Clone Wars to defend the vital [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] prison on the planet, the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]].

After the [[Capture of Even Piell/Legends|Capture of Even Piell]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] was taken to the Citadel, along with his captain, [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], because they each knew half of the important star route information that the CIS needed. The Jedi launched a rescue mission to the Citadel, and snuck by the blockade using captured and reprogrammed [[R2-D2's battle droid squadron/Legends|droids]] and a stolen [[Class type B/Legends|Class type B]] to sneak past the blockade.

After the team of Jedi and [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] freed the Even Piell, he perished because of an attack of an [[Anooba/Legends|Anooba]]. Then, a fleet of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyers]] came out of hyperspace and engaged the Lola Sayu defense fleet in battle. A group of three Jedi Starfighters and one space gunship retrieved the team from the surface and made it back to the fleet, where [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Coburn/Legends|Coburn]] commenced a retreat to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
